summary: Saskatchewan Pasquia Hills tower site with a named towerman, Einer Wicker, who later served at Pasquia Hills, English Cabin and Thunder Mountain; no build date or current site record found.

evidence.supports: Pasquia Hills lie in the east-central part of Saskatchewan, near the Manitoba border
evidence.quote: They are located in the east central part of the province in the RM of Hudson Bay No. 394 near the Manitoba border.

evidence.quote: He served as towerman at Pasquia Hills, English Cabin and Thunder Mountain Fire towers until he retired.

notes_for_editor: The towerman is documented in the websiteservice listing (dates unknown, pre 1960) and in the Wicker family story, which names Pasquia Hills, English Cabin and Thunder Mountain. The Wicker PDF spells the surname Wiker in one passage and Wicker elsewhere; the story uses Wicker, as the listing does. The agency fact is the Department of Natural Resources, which the Wicker story names for his service; no page read says who manages the site now, and the brief's SPSA line is unconfirmed. Build year, height, fate and current condition are not in any source read; the listing's height and year fields are blank. A Facebook group thread asks where an original wooden Wildcat Hill tower stood; it is unverified and not used.
